source_documents.title: Unified Framework for Photophysical Rate Calculations in TADF Molecules

reference_evidence_units.quote: In the particular case of PTZ-DBTO2, the predicted ISC rate is roughly 1 order of magnitude greater than its experimental counterpart, while the calculated rISC rate underestimates the experimental value by a factor of 3.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PTZ-DBTO2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Nuclear-ensemble ISC/rISC calculations compared with previously reported experiments.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The model estimates spin-conversion rates but has nontrivial quantitative error.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Experimental reference values are cited by the source, not independently recovered in this smoke.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the sampling procedure produces conformations that display T1 states with various different mixtures of charge transfer and localized characters.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PTZ-DBTO2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Sampled conformations and T1 natural transition orbitals.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Triplet-state electronic character varies across conformations.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This does not show a single fixed CT fraction or prove ordinary TICT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the contribution from prompt fluorescence can be seen by the small vertical line in the initial times, followed by the delayed fluorescence that results from rISC.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PTZ-DBTO2
reference_evidence_units.statement: Reverse intersystem crossing generates a delayed fluorescence component.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is the computed decay, not a new time-resolved experiment.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the calculations predict that 79% of the emission stems from fluorescence, with the remaining 21% being due to phosphorescence.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PTZ-DBTO2
reference_evidence_units.statement: The model predicts mixed fluorescence and phosphorescence contributions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The percentages are predictions and must not be presented as directly measured fractions.

reference_evidence_units.quote: an estimated lifetime of 67 μs for the delayed component.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PTZ-DBTO2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Biexponential fit to the simulated fluorescence curve.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The predicted delayed component has a 67 microsecond lifetime.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The source reports an approximately order-of-magnitude overestimate relative to experiment.

reference_evidence_units.subject: PTZ-DBTO2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 3, calculated fluorescence and phosphorescence rates alongside cited experimental fluorescence rates.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The calculated kF is 4.0 x 10^6 s^-1 and kP is 3.1 x 10^3 s^-1. The table cites an experimental kF of 6.0 x 10^7 s^-1, 15 times the calculated kF.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The factor 15 is arithmetic from this table, not a new experiment. The experimental sources (references 44 and 45) have not been recovered independently. A mechanism-level interpretation does not imply quantitative rate agreement.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Sampled NTOs explicitly establish variable CT versus localized character in the relevant triplet states.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The paper's central analysis combines emission and spin-conversion rates to predict state populations and emission contributions.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The existing family explicitly includes organic TADF and triplet photophysics. Absence of a metal cannot exclude the target's rISC pathway.
